dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, fragmented elliptical perimeters with a sharp high-contrast gradient transitioning from a dark exterior border to a light-grey speckled interior, primarily concentrated along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity white and light-grey pixel clusters located on the upper neck and interspersed between macro-annuli along the lower lateral flank, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-lateral section form an obtuse triangle, while a sequence of four smaller high-intensity blobs forms a distinctive curvilinear path following the lateral arc toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible ventral flipper features five distinct, dark, tapered digit-like projections with sharp terminal boundaries that create a high-contrast jagged edge against the lighter body segments.
